fact: The NHMIS Bulletin for June 2025 gives a national health facility reporting rate of 91.5% for the NHMIS Monthly Summary (version 2019) on DHIS2 for June 2025, charts the rate by facility type (primary, secondary and tertiary) and by ownership, and encourages states to continue deploying mobile devices and computers for direct reporting to DHIS2; it gives no count of facilities reporting directly.
title: NHMIS Bulletin, June 2025 Edition
